instruction: Navigate to the Chrome extension store and install each extension mentioned in the plugin list document that is open on your Desktop.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all 5 Chrome extensions from the document. The evaluator uses the existing is_expected_installed_extensions metric to verify all extensions are installed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts installed Chrome extension names from Preferences file (chrome.py:1438-1472)
Metric correctly checks if all 5 expected extensions are installed using subset logic (chrome.py:102-117)
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies all instruction requirements (install all 5 extensions)
Data flow is correct - getter returns List[str] of names, metric compares against expected List[str]
Expected values are accurate - these are real, popular Chrome extension names as they appear in manifests
No postconfig needed - Preferences file persists after extension installation
Logic is sound - subset check allows for additional extensions while requiring all expected ones
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding fuzzy matching or case-insensitive comparison if extension manifest names have minor variations
Could add logging to show which extensions were found vs. which are missing for better debugging
